protocol: Two single changes of LiveMemory (episodic_lab/r41b_memory.py), each through the full dev check bench/m3/run_round41b.py in a fresh copy of the lab, new process with -B.

no_cache_invalidation.change: ingest() keeps the cached results of the affected fact

no_index_update.change: ingest() writes the store but does not add the report to the per-fact index

note: Both are caught. The missing cache invalidation shows up ONLY at Q3, the question asked at the same query time as before c arrived (200 of 400 wrong: the A worlds); questions at a new query time hide it. This is why the same-time variant (Astra's request) is part of the protocol.
